description: This file defines the 'TrackerListController' class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It extends an abstract controller and sets up a Vue component for listing performance trackers, overriding the preRender method to initialize the component.

classes.name: TrackerListController
classes.description: Controller managing the performance tracker list view, sets up the Vue component for rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the 'performance-tracker-list' Vue component before rendering the view.
